protocol.scope: Original AOA/PReLU/tanh/MSE form on the new good-only dataset; training budget and unspecified optimizer details are declared reconstruction choices, not recovered historical settings.
protocol.input: K+1 raw degree-valued AOAs; one fixed network per K, no padding, phase features or output projection
protocol.labels: Unscaled stored sample-MVDR labels from 1024 interference-plus-noise snapshots; no label clipping or normalization
protocol.selection: minimum selection-validation component MSE per K
protocol.conditioning: First-layer initialization and learning rate multiplied by 1/90 to condition raw degree units; forward input stays raw AOA. Same established strict baseline helper, not a new input feature.

generation.rule: Deterministic combinatorial enumeration on the published integer-degree angular grid, with declared separations derived from the published example. This is a new reconstruction, not recovered historical data generation code.
generation.ordering: Cycle desired angles and K; use a coprime stride through lexicographic combination ranks. Interferer spacing is enforced by compressed-index unranking. No random AOA draws.
generation.split_group: desired angle; all scenes at the same desired angle stay in the same split

quality.reference: population interference-plus-noise MVDR evaluated before neural training
quality.main_rule: Nearest local power peak including one-sided endpoint maxima on a 0.1-degree scan; endpoint compared to adjacent scan sample.
quality.null_rule: One-to-one minimum-total-distance matching to interior minima on a 0.001-degree scan, with analytic derivative verification; missing minima fail.
quality.scope: Apply identical Oracle-only eligibility to all splits. Retain rejection records; no filtering on neural results. Nulls need not be computed for scenes already rejected by main error or SINR; mark these as not evaluated.

search.alternation: one weight step and one architecture-validation step after warmup

training.loss: restored physical objective; matched population-component-MSE control

controls: fixed DNNABF hidden widths with identical added input/output modules and physical loss
same searched genotype with population-component MSE
one predeclared random architecture with physical loss
protocol.test_policy: Freeze all model checkpoints and evaluator sources before any neural test prediction. The Oracle-filtered test is generated with the dataset; no training or selection reads its file. Include all frozen controls and every test scene.
protocol.scope_note: Reference-qualified, separated-angle reconstruction. Report eligibility counts. It does not reproduce the unspecified historical random-AOA distribution; no claim of unrestricted performance or DARTS superiority without matched evidence.

latency.precision: FP32 neural core; FP64 phase rotation, covariance and MVDR
